phase.lobby: Mystaria: The house is open. Nine bracelets, nine wrists. Come in, and choose your companions carefully.
phase.prologue: Mystaria: You wake in the hall. I am Mystaria, the first ghost. Look at your bracelet: it is your life now.
phase.doors: Mystaria: The doors are waking. Pair or solo, red, green or blue: decide who goes where before they close. Whoever passes no door will not see the rooms.
phase.rooms: Mystaria: The doors have closed. Three of you, one room, and the clock forgives nothing. Work together... for now.
phase.free_time: Mystaria: The doors stand open again. Wander, talk, search. Walls hide secrets, and so do friends.
phase.vote: Mystaria: To the booths. Ally or betray: no one will know what you chose... until I say so.
phase.results: Mystaria: The booths are open. Every vote, every point, laid bare. Look at who is still smiling.
phase.final: Mystaria: The last door waits. Nine points to open it. Which of you has earned them?
phase.ended: Mystaria: It is over. The house falls silent, and I... I stay.
doors_dead: Mystaria: %1$s passed no door. The house keeps them.
final_door_open: Mystaria: Door 9 has been opened! It stays open for %2$s seconds, for those who earned it. Only them.
final_door_escaped: Mystaria: Through the door: %1$s. It closes for ever behind them.
final_door_nobody: Mystaria: The door closes for ever. Nobody went through.
final_countdown: Mystaria: %1$s seconds before the last door closes for ever.
game_master_killed: Mystaria: %1$s was the game master, and was killed. Every other player wins.
role.infiltrator: Mystaria: Your secret role is Infiltrator. You must betray in round 1. If you do, you win 1 extra point.
role.ferryman: Mystaria: Your secret role is Ferryman. You are allied with the ghosts. You win if at least 2 players are ghosts at the end, even if you do not get out.
role.guardian: Mystaria: Your secret role is Guardian. You can never betray. You win if at least 5 players go through the final door.
role.seer: Mystaria: Your secret role is Seer. Once in the game, during a vote, you see the vote already cast by one side of a group.
role.gambler: Mystaria: Your secret role is Gambler. Before each vote you bet on your opponent's vote. A right bet gives 1 point, once in the game.
role.loner: Mystaria: Your secret role is Loner. You want to win alone: you win only if you are the only player through the final door.
role.game_master: Mystaria: You are the game master, and you play. Your role is secret.
letter: Mystaria: A letter reaches you, no name on it: "%1$s"
offer: Mystaria: An offer, for you alone: betray, and you win %1$s point more.
offer_made: Mystaria: An offer has just been made to one of you.
leak.vote_time: Mystaria: A rumour, and it is true: %1$s voted after %2$s seconds.
leak.cabin_closed: Mystaria: A rumour, and it is true: %1$s closed a cabin after %2$s seconds.
leak.cabin_try: Mystaria: A rumour, and it is true: %1$s tried to enter a cabin.
leak.item_found: Mystaria: A rumour, and it is true: %1$s found a hidden object.
race_first: Mystaria: First out of its room: %1$s.
death: Mystaria: %1$s will not come back. (placeholder text)
betrayal: Mystaria: At least one hand betrayed. (placeholder text)
alliance: Mystaria: Nobody betrayed this time. (placeholder text)
Mystaria: The hands stayed joined. (placeholder variant)
ending.solo: Mystaria: Only one got out: %1$s. (placeholder text)
ending.some: Mystaria: A few are leaving: %1$s. (placeholder variant)
ending.nobody: Mystaria: The house keeps everybody. (placeholder variant)
